summary: Timeboxed hashed-identifier join request to reconcile token billing with inference traces for single enterprise account
description:
Issue summary: Finance has reported a token billing discrepancy for Acme Analytics (enterprise customer). We need a timeboxed, access-controlled join between billing token events and a hashed-identifier slice of inference traces to confirm whether tokens billed map to customer sessions. Impact: potential under/overbilling affecting invoice for month M-1. Request: short-lived query that joins billing.transactions (token counts) to inference.request_traces using a salted SHA256 hashed customer_id (salted per-request to avoid exposing raw identifiers). Purpose is reconciliation only; no raw PII may leave the secure environment.

Requested by: Finance (Elena Ruiz). Business urgency: must resolve before next billing cut (2026-03-18).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Finance observed an unexpected +18% token delta vs expected from usage dashboard for account Acme Analytics for billing period 2026-02.
2) On dashboard: open Billing -> Account usage -> select Acme Analytics -> date range 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.
3) Drilldown shows token_total != sum(per-route tokens) for the account.
4) Proposed repro: run a deterministic join between billing.transactions (token_count, billing_event_id, hashed_customer_id) and a redacted subset of inference.request_traces (request_id, hashed_customer_id, model_id, timestamp, token_count) for the same period.
Note: The hashed_customer_id field already exists in billing and can be derived in traces via salt from request metadata; we will not expose raw customer_id in exports.

comments: Maya Chen (Reporter) - 2026-03-10: Finance submitted a formal ticket. Attaching signed data-handling attestation from Finance and Acme (doc link). Requesting SRE/Privacy approval for timeboxed join and export of aggregated reconciliation CSV (hashed_customer_id, billing_event_id, billing_tokens, trace_request_id, trace_tokens, model_id, timestamp).

Omar Singh (Assignee) - 2026-03-10: Acknowledge. We need Privacy sign-off and an access plan describing minimal fields, retention, and where the export will be stored. Marking for review by Privacy and Legal.

Priya Kapoor (Privacy) - 2026-03-11: Preliminary OK if: (1) salt used to hash IDs is managed by KMS and not exported, (2) CSV contains no raw identifiers or free-text prompts, (3) export stored in secure internal bucket with 7-day TTL, (4) access limited to named Finance members. Please provide query and ACLs.
Elena Ruiz (Finance) - 2026-03-11: Finance confirms only the three named users (Elena, Raj, and Tammy) need access. They accept 7-day TTL. We will not attempt re-identification.

SRE Team Lead (Jamal Ortiz) - 2026-03-12: Technical note: we can create a read-only, time-limited view in prod analytics that performs the join and writes to s3://redwood-temp/billing-recon/INT-772559/. We'll require an execution runbook and an automated deletion job. Requesting final Legal sign-off before execution.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: A routing fallback caused some requests to be served by a fallback model variant with different prompt-token accounting, creating a mismatch between billing aggregator and per-route counters. To validate: (a) verify hashed_customer_id join returns 1:1 mapping across billing events and traces; (b) compare token_count per matched pair; (c) surface any unmatched billing events. Data minimization: limit trace slice to date window 2026-02-01..2026-02-28, models listed, and only fields necessary for reconciliation. Salt rotation: use KMS key rk-prod-001; salt value not to be exported. Queries will be run from a bastion job with no interactive SSH and audited execution logs.
resolution: PENDING - awaiting Legal sign-off (requested 2026-03-12). Once Legal approves, SRE will run the join in a read-only view and produce a minimal aggregated CSV. After validation with Finance, SRE will verify deletion and publish an exec note to Confluence. If discrepancy confirmed, Finance will issue invoice adjustment and CS will notify Acme. No raw prompts or customer_id values will be exported. Full audit trail will be retained in audit-log index for 90 days.
